verdict.rationale: Community Phone's business plans include two-way SMS texting, so automatic STOP/HELP keyword handling and opt-out suppression is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never mentions keyword handling, opt-out management, or suppressing opted-out contacts from future sends. Call spam blocking and number blocking are adjacent call controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a support leader, STOP and HELP keywords are handled automatically and opted-out contacts are suppressed from future sends
